title: Halley's Comet Orbital Pass Across Earth's Sky
sys_subtitle: Periodic comet orbital pass visible to naked-eye observers from Earth
description: Scheduled 76-year orbital cycle pass testing upper atmosphere particle trail rendering.

title: Johannes Gutenberg Invents Movable Type Printing Press
sys_subtitle: Movable type technology dramatically lowers cost of book publication and literacy
description: Invention of movable type printing press accelerated book production, mass literacy, and scientific information distribution.

title: Black Death Bubonic Plague Outbreak Spreads Across Europe
sys_subtitle: Devastating pandemic leads to major demographic and economic changes
description: Yersinia pestis bacterial pandemic spread across Europe, resulting in catastrophic population decline and economic structural shifts.

title: Fall of the Western Roman Empire
sys_subtitle: Romulus Augustulus deposed as Western Roman Empire collapses
description: Collapse of Western Roman imperial authority led to regional political fragmentation into early medieval feudal kingdoms.

title: Assassination of Julius Caesar on the Ides of March
sys_subtitle: Roman dictator assassinated by senators leading to the end of the Roman Republic
description: Julius Caesar assassinated by Roman senators on the Ides of March, triggering the collapse of the Roman Republic and rise of the Empire.

title: Destruction of the Library of Alexandria Archives
sys_subtitle: Fire destroys major manuscript collections in the ancient world's largest library
description: Fire destroyed key portions of the Library of Alexandria, leading to severe loss of classical antiquity manuscripts and scientific texts.

title: Neolithic Agricultural Revolution Transforms Human Society
sys_subtitle: Transition from foraging to farming enables permanent settlements and civilization
description: Transition from hunter-gatherer foraging to plant cultivation and animal domestication enabled permanent human settlements and civilizational growth.

title: Early Hominids Master Controlled Use of Fire
sys_subtitle: Control of fire provides warmth, protection, and cooked food energy expansion
description: Early hominids mastered fire control, providing thermal protection, defense, and cooked food energy expansion.

title: Chicxulub Asteroid Impact Triggers Dinosaur Extinction
sys_subtitle: Mass extinction event clears ecological niches for mammalian evolution
description: Asteroid impact in Chicxulub caused global climate cooling, triggering the extinction of non-avian dinosaurs and expansion of mammal species.

title: Formation of Planet Earth in the Early Solar System
sys_subtitle: Planetary accretion from solar nebula dust forms planet Earth
description: Coalescence of dust and gas in the early solar nebula formed planet Earth, initiating core thermal differentiation.

title: The Big Bang & Expansion of the Physical Universe
sys_subtitle: Rapid inflation creates spacetime, energy, and fundamental physical laws
description: Origin of space, time, and matter via rapid inflation, establishing fundamental physical laws and elemental hydrogen formation.
